graph.pronoun_rule: a phrase is a pronoun when its chunk root is PRON in more than half of its occurrences (majority vote over occurrences)
graph.hub_rule_order: the hub rule runs before graphrag's counting and pruning: co-occurrence, PMI and the node and edge rules see the surviving phrases only, and graphrag's one ego node is the highest-degree content phrase left after the hub rule
graph.article_rule: every article token (a, an, the) stripped from the lemma

placebo.method: sorted by (topic, community); community targets permuted by rng(seed); bad positions repaired by pairwise swaps in rng order; weight stays with the topic endpoint
